{{Quote|The Mandies just hit the Resistance base&mdash;everyone's falling back to ''The Pit!''|Gadon Thek|<ref name="KOTOR24" />}}
'''The Pit''' was a location used by the [[Taris Resistance]] in [[3963 BBY]] as a place for the Resistance to fall back to after the [[Taris Siege|occupying]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces attacked the [[Taris Resistance Stronghold|main Resistance base]].<ref name="KOTOR24" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pit was first mentioned in [[Knights of the Old Republic 24|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 24]], written by [[John Jackson Miller]]<ref name="KOTOR24" /> and released on [[December 26]], [[2007]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54343/star_wars_knights_of_the_old_republic_2006_24|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (2006) #24}}</ref>
